review.suggestion: Hash the import bindings of names in the closure and reject differing aliases. Recorded in FINDINGS for stop 2; the lock is not created in this campaign.

review.finding: In the left_stale case the committed-versions check cannot tell a refused release commit from no release commit at all.
review.suggestion: Assert the release commit subject or the exact committed map.

review.finding: The AC11 aggregation-half test never calls the oracle although the docs say each promise test is judged through it.
review.suggestion: Add an oracle function and check per test in the meta test.

Fingerprint uniqueness check keys by bare test name across two files.
